$comment: Provided schema of a file's meta head, validated against the sample beside it (ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): the keys of the catzc block, which a tool may rely on. The head of an authored file holds its one edge first, its comment page's plain path from the file's own folder (docs), then a note that the head itself is generated (catzc.header), and no warning; a file with no comment page carries no head, and the rule codes a file cites are read from its text, never from a head. A wholly generated file's head holds warning, and with_body_sha while git tracks the file, under immutable. Every other fact about a file is derived on demand. A fact a file has no value for is left out, so no key is required.
